title: Build: serve the programme headline measure -- net P&L per capital-day (R and USD) per book and per leg, provenance-filtered -- on /api/bot/performance and in the daily brief, so every AI-trader and exit result is read against the one number the operator chose
note: [2026-10-14 lane AI-TRADER-PROGRAMME] Operator (2026-10-14 weekly planning): the headline measure is net P&L per capital-day (R and $). MEASURED on main 2026-10-14: the quantity exists only inside src/runtime/hold_vs_cash.py (capital-days reasoning) and as the net_r_per_capital_day clause of config/mandates.yaml and a few queue units (RQ-20261010-002, RQ-20261005-813); no API route or brief section serves it per book. DEFINITION TO IMPLEMENT: sum of provenance-trustworthy net R (pnl_is_trustworthy; net of fee/funding where cost_source=broker, estimate otherwise, flagged) over a window, divided by capital-days = sum over days of deployed capital (account equity for a book; risk_usd-weighted exposure-days for a leg); USD twin uses net pnl. Render null as '-' with a read_state, never 0. Tier-1 read path. DONE WHEN: GET /api/bot/performance carries netPnlPerCapitalDay {r, usd, capital_days, read_state} per book, the daily brief section 4 quotes it, and a diag pull shows a non-null value for bybit_2 over the last 30 d. [2026-10-15 PERF-FOLLOWUP-2026W42] Definition drift to resolve when this is built: the 2026-10-15 walk-through brief and giveback_census.py (RQ-20261014-9807-01) both compute 'R/cap-day' as sum(realised R)/sum(trade hold-days), size-UNWEIGHTED trade-days -- not this row's capital-days (account equity for a book; risk_usd-weighted exposure-days for a leg). The brief itself warns it inflates short-hold scalps (mes_trend_long_1d read 917). Stage-0 records have a third definition (bars*bar_minutes/1440; CAPDAY-EQUITY-DENOM in PR #18159). Until this row serves one definition, three numbers share the name G1 is measured in.
